LU1.name: Zhongfu
LU1.loc: Lateral superior chest, 6 cun lateral to midline, 1st intercostal space.
LU1.act: Clears Lung heat, descends Lung Qi, halts wheezing and cough.
LU1.saf: Oblique insertion 0.5–0.8 cun. CAUTION: Deep perpendicular insertion risks pneumothorax!

LU5.name: Chize
LU5.loc: Cubital crease of elbow, radial side of biceps brachii tendon.
LU5.act: Clears Lung heat, expels phlegm, treats coughing blood, hemoptysis.

LU7.name: Lieque
LU7.cat: Luo-Connecting • Confluent of Ren Mai • Command Point of Head & Neck
LU7.loc: Radial side of forearm, 1.5 cun proximal to transverse wrist crease.
LU7.act: Releases exterior wind, opens Ren Mai, relieves headache, stiff neck, asthma.

LU9.name: Taiyuan
LU9.loc: Radial end of wrist crease, between radial artery and abductor pollicis longus.
LU9.act: Tonifies Lung Qi and Yin, harmonizes all vessels, pulseless disease.
LU9.saf: Perpendicular 0.3–0.5 cun. Palpate and avoid radial artery!

LU11.name: Shaoshang
LU11.loc: Radial side of thumb, 0.1 cun proximal to corner of nail bed.
LU11.act: Emergency point: Revives consciousness, clears extreme throat heat, sore throat.
LU11.saf: Perpendicular 0.1 cun or prick to bleed with lancet.

LI1.name: Shangyang
LI1.loc: Radial side of index finger, 0.1 cun proximal to corner of nail bed.
LI1.act: Clears Yangming heat, revives consciousness, toothache, swollen pharynx.
LI1.saf: Perpendicular 0.1 cun or prick to bleed.

LI4.name: Hegu
LI4.cat: Yuan-Source (Metal) • Command of Face & Mouth • Four Gates
LI4.loc: Dorsum of hand, between 1st & 2nd metacarpals, midpoint of 2nd metacarpal bone.
LI4.act: Releases exterior wind, relieves any pain in head/face, expels heat, opens Four Gates.

LI10.name: Shousanli
LI10.loc: Radial side of dorsal forearm, 2 cun distal to LI11 (Quchi).
LI10.act: Harmonizes Stomach/Intestines, dispels wind-damp, clears meridian obstruction.

LI11.name: Quchi
LI11.loc: Lateral end of transverse cubital crease, midway between LU5 and lateral epicondyle.
LI11.act: Major point to clear heat and fire, cools blood, relieves hypertension, skin rashes.

LI15.name: Jianyu
LI15.cat: Crossing of LI & Yang Qiao Mai
LI15.loc: Anterior and inferior to acromion, in depression formed when arm is abducted 90°.
LI15.act: Dispels wind-damp, benefits shoulder joint, frozen shoulder, hemiplegia.

LI20.name: Yingxiang
LI20.cat: Crossing of LI & ST • Exit Point
LI20.loc: In nasolabial groove, at level of midpoint of lateral border of ala nasi.
LI20.act: Opens nasal passages, clears rhinitis, sinusitis, loss of smell, facial paralysis.
LI20.saf: Oblique or transverse medially 0.3–0.5 cun. No moxa.

ST1.name: Chengqi
ST1.cat: Crossing of ST, Yang Qiao, Ren Mai
ST1.loc: With eyes looking straight ahead, in depression between eyeball and infraorbital margin.
ST1.act: Benefits eyes, dispels wind, conjunctivitis, night blindness, optic atrophy.
ST1.saf: Push eyeball upward gently; insert perpendicular 0.5–1.0 cun slowly. NO manipulation!

ST2.name: Sibai
ST2.loc: Directly below ST1, in depression of infraorbital foramen.
ST2.act: Clears vision, relieves facial pain, trigeminal neuralgia, facial tic.
ST2.saf: Perpendicular 0.2–0.4 cun. Avoid deep penetration into infraorbital canal.

ST6.name: Jiache
ST6.loc: One finger-breadth anterior and superior to angle of jaw, on masseter prominence.
ST6.act: Relieves toothache, TMJ lockjaw, facial paralysis, mumps, swollen cheek.
ST6.saf: Perpendicular 0.3–0.5 cun or oblique toward ST4.

ST7.name: Xiaguan
ST7.loc: Anterior to ear, in depression between zygomatic arch and mandibular notch.
ST7.act: Benefits ear and jaw, tinnitus, deafness, TMJ dysfunction, toothache.

ST8.name: Touwei
ST8.cat: Crossing of ST, GB, Yang Wei Mai
ST8.loc: Corner of forehead, 0.5 cun directly above anterior hairline, 4.5 cun lateral to DU24.
ST8.act: Dispels wind, clears head, frontal and Yangming headache, dizziness with phlegm.

ST25.name: Tianshu
ST25.loc: Abdomen, 2 cun lateral to center of umbilicus (REN8).

ST28.name: Shuidao

ST35.name: Dubi

ST35.act: Dispels wind-damp, benefits knee joint, knee swelling and osteoarthritis.

ST36.name: Zusanli

ST38.name: Tiaokou

ST38.act: Empirical distal point for frozen shoulder; mobilize shoulder during needle retention.

ST40.name: Fenglong

ST44.name: Neiting

ST45.name: Lidui

SP9.name: Yinlingquan

SP10.name: Xuehai

SP21.name: Dabao

BL60.name: Kunlun

BL62.name: Shenmai

KI10.name: Yingu

PC7.name: Daling

PC9.name: Zhongchong

SJ3.name: Zhongzhu

SJ5.name: Waiguan

SJ5.act: Releases exterior wind-heat, clears Shaoyang heat, treats migraine, ear infections, stiff neck.

SJ6.name: Zhigou

SJ14.name: Jianliao

SJ17.name: Yifeng

SJ21.name: Ermen

GB1.name: Tongziliao

GB1.act: Benefits eyes, clears heat, treats headache, eye redness, night blindness, optic neuritis.

GB2.name: Tinghui

GB2.act: Clears heat from Shaoyang, benefits ear, treats severe tinnitus, sudden deafness, jaw pain.

GB8.name: Shuaigu
GB8.loc: Directly superior to apex of ear, 1.5 cun within hairline.
GB8.act: Relieves one-sided migraine headache, pacifies wind, treats hangover, infantile convulsion.

GB14.name: Yangbai

GB20.name: Fengchi

GB20.act: Premier point for all interior and exterior wind diseases, stiff neck, headache, hypertension.

GB21.name: Jianjing

GB34.name: Yanglingquan

GB39.name: Xuanzhong

LV14.name: Qimen

DU15.name: Yamen
DU15.cat: Gate of Muteness • Sea of Qi
DU15.loc: Posterior midline, 0.5 cun superior to posterior hairline, in depression below C1.
DU15.act: Benefits tongue, treats loss of speech, muteness, epilepsy, stiff tongue.
DU15.saf: Perpendicular 0.5–0.8 cun. STRICT CAUTION: Deep superior insertion enters medulla oblongata!

DU16.name: Fengfu
DU16.cat: Palace of Wind • Sea of Marrow
DU16.loc: Posterior midline, 1 cun superior to posterior hairline, in depression below external occipital protuberance.
DU16.act: Dispels wind, clears head, treats stroke, stiff neck, dizziness, suicidal depression.
DU16.saf: Perpendicular 0.5–0.8 cun. STRICT CAUTION: Never angle needle upward toward brain!

DU20.name: Baihui
DU20.loc: Vertex of head, 5 cun posterior to anterior hairline, midway on line connecting ear apexes.
DU20.act: Raises sunken Yang Qi (prolapse of rectum/uterus), calms Shen, clears mind, treats headache.
DU20.saf: Subcutaneous transverse 0.5–0.8 cun anteriorly or posteriorly.

DU24.name: Shenting
DU24.loc: 0.5 cun directly above anterior hairline on midline.
DU24.act: Calms Shen, treats insomnia, emotional agitation, mania, frontal headache, rhinitis.

DU26.name: Shuigou
DU26.loc: At junction of upper 1/3 and lower 2/3 of philtrum groove.
DU26.act: Premier emergency resuscitation point: restores consciousness from coma, fainting, shock.
DU26.saf: Oblique superiorly 0.3–0.5 cun. Pinch firmly with thumbnail in crisis.

REN3.name: Zhongji
REN3.loc: Anterior midline of lower abdomen, 4 cun below umbilicus (1 cun above pubic symphysis).
REN3.act: Drains damp-heat from Bladder, treats dysuria, urinary retention, enuresis, genital itch.
REN3.saf: Perpendicular 0.8–1.2 cun. CAUTION: Must empty bladder prior to needling!

REN4.name: Guanyuan
REN4.cat: Front-Mu of Small Intestine • Gate of Origin
REN4.loc: Anterior midline of lower abdomen, 3 cun below umbilicus.
REN4.act: Nourishes Original Qi (Yuan Qi), warms Kidney Yang, treats chronic exhaustion, impotence.
REN4.saf: Perpendicular 0.8–1.5 cun. CAUTION: Empty bladder first! CONTRAINDICATED in pregnancy!

REN6.name: Qihai
REN6.loc: Anterior midline of lower abdomen, 1.5 cun below umbilicus.
REN6.act: Tonifies Qi, raises sunken Yang, treats general fatigue, shortness of breath, diarrhea.

REN8.name: Shenque
REN8.act: Warms Yang, rescues from Yang collapse, chronic diarrhea, prolapse, shock.
REN8.saf: NEEDLING IS STRICTLY FORBIDDEN! Apply moxa with salt or ginger slice only!

REN12.name: Zhongwan
REN12.cat: Front-Mu of Stomach • Hui-Meeting of Fu Organs
REN12.loc: Anterior midline, 4 cun superior to umbilicus.
REN12.act: Harmonizes Middle Burner, treats all Stomach and digestive diseases, epigastric pain.
REN12.saf: Perpendicular 1.0–1.5 cun. CAUTION: Avoid puncture in peritoneal inflammation.

REN17.name: Shanzhong
REN17.cat: Front-Mu of Pericardium • Hui-Meeting of Qi
REN17.loc: Anterior midline, in depression on sternum level with 4th intercostal space.
REN17.act: Regulates Qi, unbinds chest, treats chest oppression, wheezing, insufficient lactation.
REN17.saf: Subcutaneous transverse 0.3–0.5 cun along sternum. Never needle perpendicular!

REN22.name: Tiantu
REN22.loc: In center of suprasternal fossa, 0.5 cun superior to suprasternal notch.
REN22.act: Descends rebellious Lung Qi, clears throat, relieves severe asthma, sudden hoarseness.
REN22.saf: Perpendicular 0.2 cun, then angle needle downward behind manubrium 0.5–1.0 cun. CAUTION: Trachea & aorta proximity!

REN24.name: Chengjiang
REN24.loc: Anterior midline of chin, in depression of mentolabial groove.
REN24.act: Dispels wind, treats facial paralysis, sudden swelling of gums, excessive salivation.

YINTANG.name: Yintang
YINTANG.loc: At midpoint between medial ends of eyebrows (glabella).
YINTANG.act: Calms Shen, treats insomnia, frontal headache, rhinitis, infantile convulsions.
YINTANG.saf: Subcutaneous transverse inferiorly 0.3–0.5 cun. Pinch skin while inserting.

TAIYANG.name: Taiyang
TAIYANG.loc: In depression approximately 1 cun posterior to midpoint between lateral eyebrow and outer canthus.
TAIYANG.act: Clears heat, halts migraine, temporal headache, eye inflammation, toothache.
TAIYANG.saf: Perpendicular 0.5–0.8 cun, or prick to bleed for red swollen eyes.

SISHENCONG.name: Sishencong
SISHENCONG.loc: Group of 4 points on vertex, each 1 cun anterior, posterior, and bilateral to DU20.
SISHENCONG.act: Calms Shen, sharpens memory, treats insomnia, cognitive decline, dizziness, epilepsy.

DINGCHUAN.name: Dingchuan
DINGCHUAN.loc: 0.5 cun lateral to lower border of spinous process of C7 vertebra (DU14).
DINGCHUAN.act: Calms wheezing, halts acute asthma attack, relieves coughing and bronchial spasm.
DINGCHUAN.saf: Perpendicular or slightly oblique toward spine 0.5–0.8 cun.

HUATUOJIAJI.name: Huatuojiaji
HUATUOJIAJI.loc: 0.5 cun lateral to lower border of each spinous process from T1 through L5 (34 points total).
HUATUOJIAJI.act: Regulates autonomic and spinal nerve root functions corresponding to segmental dermatomes.

YAOTONGXUE.name: Yaotongxue
YAOTONGXUE.cat: Lumbar Pain Point (2 points on dorsum of hand)
YAOTONGXUE.loc: Dorsum of hand, between 2nd/3rd and 4th/5th metacarpal bases.
YAOTONGXUE.act: Acute lumbar sprain, sudden muscle spasm, low back trauma.
YAOTONGXUE.saf: Oblique 0.5–1.0 cun toward center of palm with active lumbar mobilization!

SIFENG.name: Sifeng
SIFENG.loc: Palmar surface of 2nd to 5th fingers, in center of proximal interphalangeal creases.
SIFENG.act: Childhood malnutrition (Gan syndrome), pediatric food retention, whooping cough.
SIFENG.saf: Prick with lancet to squeeze out small droplet of yellowish fluid or blood.

HEDING.name: Heding
HEDING.loc: In depression above midpoint of superior border of patella.
HEDING.act: Crane's knee Bi syndrome, knee osteoarthritis, patellar tendonitis, weakness of legs.

DANNANGXUE.name: Dannangxue
DANNANGXUE.loc: 1 to 2 cun directly inferior to GB34 (Yanglingquan), tender on palpation.
DANNANGXUE.act: Acute and chronic cholecystitis, gallstones, biliary colic, leg Bi pain.

LANWEIXUE.name: Lanweixue
LANWEIXUE.loc: Approximately 2 cun directly inferior to ST36 (Zusanli) on right leg, tender to pressure.
LANWEIXUE.act: Acute and chronic appendicitis, intestinal carbuncle, drop foot, indigestion.

ZIGONG.name: Zigong
ZIGONG.loc: Lower abdomen, 4 cun below umbilicus (level with REN3), 3 cun lateral to midline.
ZIGONG.act: Female infertility, uterine prolapse, dysmenorrhea, irregular menses, pelvic pain.

ST12.name: Quepen
ST12.loc: Midpoint of supraclavicular fossa, 4 cun lateral to midline.
ST12.act: Descends rebellious Qi, cough, asthma, throat pain, scrofula.
ST12.saf: Oblique posterior 0.3–0.5 cun. STRICT CAUTION: Deep puncture risks pneumothorax!

ST18.name: Rugen
ST18.loc: In 5th intercostal space, directly below nipple, 4 cun lateral to midline.
ST18.act: Unbinds chest, promotes lactation, mastitis, chest fullness.
ST18.saf: Transverse or oblique 0.5–0.8 cun along rib. CAUTION: Pneumothorax risk!

ST30.name: Qichong
ST30.cat: Sea of Water and Grain • Chong Mai Meeting
ST30.loc: Groin, 5 cun below umbilicus, 2 cun lateral to midline (level with superior border of pubic symphysis).
ST30.act: Regulates Lower Burner Qi, treats hernia, genital swelling, irregular menses.
ST30.saf: Perpendicular 0.5–1.0 cun. Palpate and avoid femoral artery!

GB26.name: Daimai
GB26.loc: Directly below free end of 11th rib (LV13), level with umbilicus (REN8).
GB26.act: Regulates Dai Mai and uterus, treats leukorrhea, amenorrhea, abdominal cramping.

SI16.name: Tianchuang
SI16.loc: Lateral neck, posterior border of sternocleidomastoid, level with Adam's apple.
SI16.act: Benefits hearing and throat, treats sudden deafness, tinnitus, goiter.
SI16.saf: Perpendicular 0.5–0.8 cun. Avoid internal jugular vein.
